notes:
Inbound SMB healthcare/wellness lead. Mostly public cloud; wants Hosted API for fast time-to-value and self-serve POC. HIPAA-adjacent — theyre a small telehealth front-end company that stores limited patient identifiers in their CRM but prefer LLM calls to not persist any PHI. Key snippets from calls:
- "We aren't ready for a BAA but need assurance that model outputs and raw prompts aren't retained long-term."
- "Primary UX: in-chat triage + doc search for intake forms and care protocols. Speed is important but cost-sensitive."
- Wants embeddings for semantic search across intake docs; 99thpct latency target ~250ms for short chat completions, throughput modest (~100-200 reqs/min during daytime peak).
Security asks (summary): audit log visibility, configurable retention/auto-delete of prompts, KMS integration for keys, and US data residency. They asked whether Redwood offers a no-retention mode for Hosted API or token redaction during ingestion.
Operational notes: leaning toward self-serve sign-up to validate flows with free credits. AE recommended initial PoC against a redacted dataset and provided link to retention options doc. Customer quote: "If we can prove no-PHI writes and short retention, legal may greenlight a small pilot."
Typical CRM shorthand in threads: follow-up@legal, send retention options, schedule se-call, upload sample corpus.
requirements_summary: Workload: chat + embeddings (doc-search) + summarization. Latency target: ~250ms 99th for chat; throughput ~100-200 rps during peaks (burst tolerant). Cost sensitivity: high (SMB). Model preference: open/efficient models OK if parity on quality; prefer deterministic fallback routing. Routing/fallback: want autopolicy to fallback to cheaper variant under load. Security/compliance: audit logs, configurable retention windows, KMS, US residency. No BAA for now but need HIPAA-adjacent assurances.
notes_short: SMB inbound; Hosted API POC; HIPAA-adjacent retention questions; wants retention controls + audit logs; schedule SE call.
